name: 利用乳幼児の健康診断の扱いを変更
summary: 条例では、家庭的保育事業者等が利用乳幼児の健康診断を行うことを定めています。この議案では、児童相談所等での利用開始前の健康診断や母子保健法に基づく健康診査が同等と認められる場合、事業者が健康診断の全部または一部を省略できるようにし、その結果を把握することも定めます。
changes: 別に行われた健康診断等が同等と認められる場合、事業者が健康診断の全部または一部を省略できるようにする
省略する場合、別に行われた健康診断等の結果を事業者が把握することを定める
who: 家庭的保育事業等を利用する乳幼児の保護者
why: 内閣府令の改正に伴い、利用乳幼児の健康診断に関する規定を改め、必要な規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how health checks are handled for children using childcare services
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Itabashi City Ordinance Establishing Standards for Equipment and Operation of Home-Based Childcare Services, etc.
en.summary: The ordinance requires home-based childcare providers and others to conduct health checks for the infants and young children using their services. This bill allows providers to omit all or part of a health check when a health check conducted before the child starts using the service at a child guidance center or elsewhere, or a health examination under the Maternal and Child Health Act, is considered equivalent. It also requires providers to obtain the results of those checks or examinations.
changes: Allow providers to omit all or part of a health check when a separately conducted health check or examination is considered equivalent
Require providers who omit a health check to obtain the results of the separately conducted health check or examination
who: Parents or guardians of infants and young children using home-based childcare services and others
en.why: The ward says this is to revise provisions on health checks for infants and young children using childcare services, and to make other necessary changes, following an amendment to a Cabinet Office Order.
